criteria.text: Dropping one or multiple browser File objects anywhere on the enabled live composer prevents browser navigation and adds them to the existing live pending-attachment list. The existing file input and existing send-time resolveLiveAttachment pipeline remain the single source of behavior.
A dropped image visibly appears before send with filename and MIME type; sending follows the current image data-URL path unchanged. Text/PDF/other files retain current handling and size guard.
criteria.reason: Direct evidence: composer-drop-c2 asserts PDF data URL resolution, other-binary file: handling, and 20 MiB + 1 byte rejection with the file pending and no new session.input frame.

criteria.text: dragenter/dragover provides a clear but restrained drop-zone affordance and accessible status text (Drop files to attach); it clears on dragleave/drop. Do not create an extra upload panel.
Read-only/disabled composers never accept the drop. Prevent navigation and show a clear existing feedback/notification reason.

Add Playwright evidence that constructs a real DataTransfer/File, drops screenshot.png onto the live composer, observes it in Pending attachments, and verifies the browser remains on the chat. Also cover multiple files or disabled rejection with the smallest useful check.

Every provider group that has models has its own compact accessible search input visually alongside that provider's header (not nested inside a button; no nested interactive controls). Placeholder may be Search <provider> models and accessible name must include provider.
Typing filters only that provider's rows, case-insensitively by display name or model ID. Other providers and the existing global provider/model search are unchanged.
The provider remains visible when its local search has no matches and shows No matching models for this provider.
Expanding/collapsing via the provider toggle still works; local search state survives collapsing during the page session.

All / none applies only to the currently displayed rows when a provider-local or global search is active, avoiding bulk changes to hidden models. With no search, it retains current all-provider behavior. Its checked/mixed state reflects that same displayed set.
Extend #1580 Playwright tests for provider isolation, name/id match, no-results, keyboard/accessibility, and screenshot evidence at the existing representative viewport.

In ModelCurationPanel, while either the global search term or that provider's local search is active, change visible text All / none to All / none shown and accessible name from Show all <provider> models to Show all displayed <provider> models. With neither filter, keep the current text/name.
Give dynamic No matching models for this provider. role=status.
Extend #1580 tests to assert both visible and accessible labels under local AND global filtering, and assert the no-results message has status role.
